prog='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    boxes=[]
    for r0 in range(h):
        for c0 in range(w):
            v=g[r0][c0]
            if v==0: continue
            for r1 in range(r0+2,h):
                for c1 in range(c0+2,w):
                    if g[r1][c1]!=v: continue
                    if all(g[r0][j]==v and g[r1][j]==v for j in range(c0,c1+1)) and \
                       all(g[i][c0]==v and g[i][c1]==v for i in range(r0,r1+1)):
                        boxes.append((v,r0,c0,r1,c1))
    border_colors={b[0] for b in boxes}
    noise={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v and v not in border_colors:
                noise.setdefault(v,[]).append((i,j))
    # match noise colors (by count asc) to boxes (by interior area asc)
    colors=sorted(noise,key=lambda c: len(noise[c]))
    bxs=sorted(boxes,key=lambda b:(b[3]-b[0]-1)*(b[4]-b[1]-1))
    for c,b in zip(colors,bxs):
        _,r0,c0,r1,c1=b
        p0=(r0+c0+2)%2  # parity of interior top-left... use (r0+1+c0+1)
        for i in range(r0+1,r1):
            for j in range(c0+1,c1):
                if (i+j)%2==p0: g[i][j]=c
    for c,pts in noise.items():
        for i,j in pts: g[i][j]=0
    return g
'''
